title: How long does SCIM deprovisioning take?

posts.author: oliver_admin
posts.body: If a contractor is removed from Okta, how quickly does NimbusFlow disable their access?

posts.author: legacy_partner
posts.body: In our tenant it looked like an hourly sync. We told our help desk to expect up to 60 minutes.

posts.author: openops_noah
posts.body: That was true on older workspaces before automatic retries shipped. Newer Enterprise workspaces should see updates much faster, especially after enabling the retry queue.
